# Lab 1.9: Gemini in BigQuery: SQL Assist

## What We Are Going to Do
Turn on Gemini in BigQuery, then generate SQL from a comment, use code completion, and explain and fix a broken query.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Enable the Gemini API.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable cloudaicompanion.googleapis.com
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member="user:$(gcloud config get-value account)" \
  --role="roles/cloudaicompanion.user"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Turn on the features.** In Studio, click the **Gemini** icon in the query editor toolbar and make sure **SQL generation**, **SQL completion** and **Explanation** are ticked.

3. **[Console] Generate SQL from a comment.** In a new query tab, type:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;"># Using bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips,
# show the 5 start stations with the most trips in 2023</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Press **Enter**. Gemini suggests a query. Press **Tab** to accept it and run it.

4. **[Console] Explain a query.** Select the generated query, right-click and choose **Explain this query**. Read the explanation in the Gemini pane.

5. **[Console] Fix a broken query.** Run this on purpose:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT start_station_name, COUNT(*) trips
FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
GROUP start_station_name;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   When the error appears, click **Gemini → Fix it**. Review the diff (`GROUP BY` added) and accept it.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Comment to SQL | Working query generated |
| Explanation | Plain-English summary of the query |
| Fix | Missing `BY` added |
| Rule | Always review AI-generated SQL before running |
